page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with short reference paragraphs set in the same column. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right, reference line at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: juxta hæc testimonia, quibus σύμφωνα [?] colligere, religiosæ uestræ diligentiæ fuerit.
Ier.10.10. Iehouah autem Deus ueritas (seu uerus) est: ipse Deus uiuens, & rex æternus.
Deut.6.4. Iehouah Deus noster, Iehouah unus est.
2.Par.6.18. Sed nū uere habitabit Deus cum homine super terram? ecce, cœlum & cœli cœlorum non capiunt te, quanto minus domus hæc quam ædificaui?

1.Tim.6.15. Beatus ille & solus Princeps, Rex regum, & Dominus dominorum. 16. qui solus habet immortalitatem, lucem habitans inaccessam: quem uidit nemo hominum, neq; uidere potest; cui honor & robur æternum. Amen.
2. Est enim Spiritus, qui solus αὐτάρκεια [?] obtinet immensam, liberrimam, omnipotentem, iustam, bonam, sapientem, &c. iuxta hæc dicta:
Ier.23.24. An non cœlū & terram ego impleo, dicit Dominus?

page.notes: The Greek words at "σύμφωνα" and "αὐτάρκεια" are hard to read at this scan resolution; both are marked [?]. The section marker "§ 5" and the reference "Psal.115." are set as a line at the foot of the text, not as a heading. The printed "2.Par.6.18" and "Ier.10.10." lines have no space after the first dot in the scan; they are copied with a space for readability.
